entries.name: Commercial Cerac CeO2 powder
entries.caption: Purchased Cerac CeO2 powder used as the coarser-powder sintering comparator. The source reports nominal 0.6 µm particles and describes aggregates with approximately 100 nm primary crystallites. The commercial synthesis recipe is not provided. This identity card does not describe the electrochemically synthesized powder.
limitations: Source-defined purchased-powder identity/context only; no measured molecular geometry, new crystal coordinates or commercial production recipe.
Nominal particle size and primary crystallite size have different bases; neither is the sintered grain size.
